syntactic_simplification: Mice are important for studying the brain. They are useful because scientists can control and study them easily. Researchers have usually used male mice in tests. This choice is because female mice have hormone cycles. These cycles can change behavior and affect the results.
lexical_simplification: Mice are important for studying the brain. They are useful because scientists can manage and look at them easily. Researchers have usually used male mice in tests. This choice is because female mice have hormone changes. These changes can alter behavior and affect the results.
paraphrase_or_explanation: Mice are important for studying how the brain works. They are easy to manage and observe, which helps scientists learn. Researchers often choose male mice for experiments. They do this because female mice go through hormone changes every month. These changes can affect how female mice behave, which might mess up the results of the experiments.
prompt_used: You simplify complex texts for the following target group: laypeople with no domain knowledge. Rewrite the text in plain language to make it easily understandable for them.
source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are important for studying how the brain works. They are easy to manage and observe, which helps scientists learn. Researchers often choose male mice for experiments because female mice have monthly hormone changes. These changes can affect their behavior, which might spoil the experiment results.
